transcript: Speaker A (Doctor): Patient ka condition kya hai? [What is the patient's condition?] Speaker B (Raju): Sir, BP kam hai aur woh breathing mein problem hai. [Sir, BP is low and there is a breathing problem.] Speaker A: BP kam hai matlab kya reading hai? Systolic batao, diastolic batao, oxygen saturation kya hai? Kuch bhi technical nahi pata tumhein? [BP is low means what is the reading? Tell me systolic, tell me diastolic, what is the oxygen saturation? You don't know anything technical?] Speaker B: Sir, machine mein 80 aur 50 dikha raha tha. [Sir, the machine was showing 80 and 50.] Speaker A: 80/50 bolo, hypotension bolo, SpO2 batao. Ambulance driver ho, itna bhi nahi aata? Kisne diya tumhein license? [Say 80/50, say hypotension, tell me SpO2. You are an ambulance driver, you don't even know this much? Who gave you a license?] Speaker B: Sir, may I say something? Speaker A: Bol. [Speak.] Speaker B: Sir, the patient is a 55-year-old male. He presented with acute chest pain radiating to the left arm. Onset was approximately 40 minutes ago. He has a history of hypertension, no known allergies. We administered oxygen at 4 liters per minute and positioned him at 45 degrees during transit. BP at the time of pickup was 90 over 60, current SpO2 is 94 percent. Speaker A: Raju, tumne yeh kab seekha? [Raju, when did you learn this?] Speaker B: Sir, teen mahine pehle aapne mujhe sabke saamne bola tha, ambulance log sirf gaadi chalana jaante hain. Us raat bahut bura laga tha, par gussa nahi kiya, seekhne ka decide kiya. [Sir, three months ago you told me in front of everyone that ambulance people only know how to drive. That night I felt very bad, but I didn't get angry, I decided to learn.] Speaker A: Kaise seekha? [How did you learn?] Speaker B: Sir, English Seekho app download ki. General English show se start kiya. 'Hello' se baat shuru karein. Pehla video 1,65,000 log dekh chuke the. Basic English seekhi, phir medical terms khud practice kiye. [Sir, downloaded the English Seekho app. Started with the General English show. 'Start talking with Hello'. The first video was already watched by 1,65,000 people. Learnt basic English, then practiced medical terms myself.] Speaker A: Medical English kahan se? [From where did you learn medical English?] Speaker B: AI Coach hai sir, 24 ghante available hai. Maine bola mujhe patient handover dena hai English mein. AI Coach ne sikha diya. The patient is approximately 40-year-old male presenting with no known allergies. Vital signs were recorded at the time of pickup. Ek ek line practice ki. 500 baar galat bola, 500 baar sudhara. Kabhi nahi boli AI Coach ne ki ambulance driver hai tujhse nahi hoga. [There is an AI Coach sir, available 24 hours. I said I want to give patient handover in English. AI Coach taught me. 'The patient is approximately 40-year-old male presenting with no known allergies. Vital signs were recorded at the time of pickup.' Practiced line by line. Spoke wrong 500 times, corrected 500 times. The AI Coach never said 'you are an ambulance driver, you can't do it'.] Speaker A: Kal ka form dikhao. [Show yesterday's form.] Speaker B: Sir, yeh raha. Chief complaint male, 40 years, road traffic accident, complaint of severe pain in the right leg and abrasion on the forehead. Vitals BP 130/85 mm Hg, SpO2 97%, pulse 92 bpm. Allergies non-reported. First aid: wound cleaned, splint applied to right leg, oxygen administered at 2 liters per minute. Speaker A: Yeh tune likha hai? [Did you write this?] Speaker B: Haan sir. Roz raat ko duty ke baad AI Coach se practice karta hoon, form likhta hoon, sudharti hai. Handover bolta hoon, correct karti hai. Ab har patient ka handover English mein deta hoon. [Yes sir. Every night after duty I practice with AI Coach, write forms, it corrects them. I speak handovers, it corrects them. Now I give every patient's handover in English.] Speaker A: Raju, I owe you an apology. Speaker B: Sir, apology ki zaroorat nahi hai. Bas ek request hai, baaki ambulance staff ko bhi English seekhne ka mauka do. English Seekho app hai, General English show se start karein. AI Coach se practice karein, roz 15 minute. Ek mahine mein handover English mein denge, patient ki care better hogi aur koi humein sirf gaadi chalane wala nahi bolega. [Sir, no need for an apology. Just one request, give other ambulance staff a chance to learn English too. There is the English Seekho app, start with the General English show. Practice with AI Coach, 15 minutes daily. In one month they will give handovers in English, patient care will be better and no one will call us just drivers.] Speaker C (Voiceover): Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]

summary: An ambulance driver, previously humiliated by a doctor for his lack of English and technical skills, demonstrates his newly acquired medical English fluency. He explains how he used the English Seekho app's AI Coach to practice patient handovers and forms. The doctor apologizes, and the driver urges others to download the app to improve patient care and earn professional respect.
